# AF 第一章 原文基线（清理对齐版 v0.1）

## Chapter One

[P01] Mr. Jones of the Manor Farm locked the hen-houses for the night. But he was too drunk to remember the small doors. His lantern light danced. He lurched（踉跄着走） across the yard. At the back door he kicked off his boots. He drank a last glass of beer. Then he went to bed. Mrs. Jones was already snoring.

[P02] When the light in the bedroom went out, all the farm animals began to move and flap（拍打）. Word had gone round that day that old Major, the prize Middle White boar, had a strange dream the night before. He wanted to tell the other animals about it. They agreed to meet in the big barn（谷仓） as soon as Mr. Jones was safely away. Old Major was so respected that everyone was ready to lose an hour's sleep to hear what he had to say.

[P03] At one end of the big barn, on a platform（舞台）, Major was on his bed of straw（稻草）, under a lantern. He was twelve years old and fat, but still a majestic（威严的） pig with a wise and kind look. Presently, as the animals arrived, he lay down on his side.

[P04] First came the three dogs, Bluebell, Jessie, and Pincher. Then came the pigs. They sat down in the straw in front of the platform. The hens sat on the window-sills. The pigeons flew up to the rafters（椽子）. The sheep and cows lay down behind the pigs. The two cart-horses, Boxer and Clover, came in together. They walked very slowly and put down their big hoofs（蹄） with great care. Clover was a stout（肥胖的）, motherly mare（母马） near middle life. Boxer was huge, not very clever, but every animal respected him for his steady（平稳） character and tremendous（极大的） power to work. After the horses came Muriel, the white goat, and Benjamin, the donkey. Benjamin was the oldest animal, and the worst tempered. He seldom talked, and when he did, it was usually to make some cynical（冷嘲的） remark（评论）. Last of all came the cat. She looked round for the warmest place.

[P05] When all the animals were there, Major began: "Now, comrades（同志们）, what is our life like? Let us face it: our lives are miserable（悲惨的）, full of labour（劳作）, and short. We are born, we get just enough food, and those who can work are forced to work until they have no strength left... No animal in England knows happiness or rest. No animal in England is free. The life of an animal is misery and slavery（奴役）: that is the plain truth."

[P06] "But must things be this way? Is our land too poor? No, comrades, a thousand times no! The soil of England is rich... it could feed many more animals. Our farm could feed a dozen horses... it grows enough for five. So why do we live in this miserable（悲惨的） way? Because men steal nearly all the food we make. That is the answer—Man. Man is the only animal that eats and makes nothing. He does not give milk, he does not lay eggs, he is too weak to pull the plough, he cannot catch rabbits. Yet he is the lord（老爷） of all animals. He makes them work, gives them little food, and keeps the rest. Our work turns the soil, our dung（粪便） makes it rich, and none of us owns more than his own skin（皮肤）. You cows... how much milk have you given? Where did it go?... And the hens... how many eggs?... And you, Clover, where are those four foals（小马） you had?... In the end, no animal escapes the knife."

[P07] "That, friends, answers all our problems. One word—Man. Remove（移开） Man, and hunger and too much work end for ever."

[P08] "Remember, comrades, I do not know when that Rebellion（造反） will come—in a week or in a hundred years. But late（迟早） justice will be done, as surely as I see this straw. Fix your eyes on that, comrades. Let us animals be in perfect unity（团结）. All men are enemies. All animals are comrades."

[P09] "Anything on two legs is an enemy. Anything on four legs, or with wings, is a friend. When we fight Man, we must not become like him. Do not take his bad ways. No animal must live in a house, or sleep in a bed, or wear clothes, or drink alcohol（酒精）, or touch money. All Man's habits are bad. No animal must ever be a tyrant（暴君） over his own kind... All animals are equal."

[P10] "And now, comrades, I will tell you my dream last night... it was the earth when Man is gone... I cannot describe it... I have little time left... I must pass it on to you."

[P11] Major says when he was young, his mother and other sows（母猪） sang an old tune（曲调）, Beasts（野兽） of England. He knows the tune and three words. "It is time that I passed it on to you."

[P12] Old Major sang: "Beasts of England, beasts of every land, hear my joyful news of the golden future." The animals sang it five times, then seven times.

[P13] The singing woke the farm. The cows lowed and the dogs barked. Jones woke up.

[P14] Jones grabbed（抓住） his gun and fired into the dark. The shots hit the barn wall. The meeting ended fast. Everyone ran to their sleeping places. The birds jumped onto their perches, the animals lay in the straw, and the farm was soon asleep.
